name: gwhyyy_outreach_status
description: Read sender readiness, caps, drafts, replies and suppressions. Never sends.

name: gwhyyy_outreach_balance
description: Check configured email provider credentials and credits. Never sends.

name: gwhyyy_outreach_preview
description: Preview exact plain-text email, sender, reply-to and unsubscribe footer before approval.

name: gwhyyy_outreach_save_draft
description: Create/edit an outreach draft. Never sends. Editing clears approval. Live drafts require a prospect; test recipients must be allowlisted.

name: gwhyyy_outreach_send
description: SEND ONE already-approved message. Requires explicit user authorization, confirm=true and hash from preview. Caps/suppression/approval rechecked. Never retry uncertain outcomes. Prospect approval is dashboard-only.

name: gwhyyy_outreach_pause
description: Pause or resume dispatch. Resuming does not send anything, approve drafts or bypass test mode.

name: gwhyyy_outreach_sync
description: Poll replies and delivery stats. Any reply stops further cold sends. No new email is sent.

name: gwhyyy_outreach_suppress
description: Permanently block an address from future cold outreach, including reply STOP or unsubscribe requests.
